English: May 14, 1985 – We’re outta here. And, what a lucky break, I'll be driving a truck in the first convoy going from our area. I can't wait to leave this island. Okay, so we’ve taken an ass-kicking – but at least I’m going to be getting out alive…
Strange Meeting
Get in the truck as the driver.
Drive to Morton.
Get ready in Morton to evacuate from Everon island.
Go to the farm on the right side of the road. Check the situation and eliminate any enemy units.
Get to the new US secret extraction point. It's North of Morton.

After the disaster at Montignac, the enemy has gained the upper hand. NATO has decided to withdraw from Everon altogether and regroup on Malden. You're going to Morton to evacuate from the island.

You start here in the jeep with your commander, near Le Moule.
